description: This file outlines the interface for the BreeSpo reader helper API, defining function prototypes for reading, opening, closing, and validating sources as part of the BSP Run-time Execution Engine (BREE).

methods.name: BreeSpoReaderValid
methods.description: Checks if the BreeSpo reader object is valid.

methods.name: BreeSpoReaderRead
methods.description: Reads data from the BreeSpo reader into a buffer.

methods.name: BreeSpoReaderOpenExternal
methods.description: Opens an external source with the specified name.

methods.name: BreeSpoReaderOpenInternal
methods.description: Opens an internal content source with specified name and content.

methods.name: BreeSpoReaderGetTemplateName
methods.description: Retrieves the template name associated with the current reader.
